newsitem.title: SPAIN: BBV sells around two pct of Iberdrola.
newsitem.headline: BBV sells around two pct of Iberdrola.

text.p: Spain's Banco Bilbao Vizcaya is selling around two percent of electricity firm Iberdrola from its own stake at 1,815 pesetas per share, market sources told Reuters on Tuesday.
The bank and its brokerage arm declined to comment.
Several dealers, who asked not to be named, said the shares were being offered this morning to domestic and foreign institutions.
The total value of the deal was over 33 billion pesetas.
Before the move, BBV's stake in Iberdrola was around 10 percent.

The sources said the operation is being managed by BBV's broking arm, BBV Interactivos and UK brokerage Morgan Stanley. It will be announced officially after the bourse closes at 1500 GMT, the sources added.
At 1015 GMT Iberdrola was down 50 pesetas, 2.67 percent, to 1,820 pesetas, while the Ibex-35 blue chip index was down 0.2 percent tO 7,190.27
